6121 has no prime divisor ≤ √6121 ≈ 78.2, so 6121 is prime.  
Thus the required divisibility is by primes 2213, 3323, and 6121.

For \(P = 2^k k!\), where \(k=n/2\), each odd prime \(p\) divides \(P\) iff \(k \ge p\).  
The largest prime is \(6121\), so the smallest possible \(k\) is \(6121\).

\[
n = 2k = 2(6121) = 12242
\]

\boxed{12242}
